definitions.gloss: end of (a month, year, or other period)
definitions.explanation: Attached to a word for a period of time to mean its last part: the end of the month, the end of the year, the end of the term. Mostly written and businesslike.

examples.japanese: ⟦{月末|げつまつ}→月末：00070_getsumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧。
examples.english: I pay at the end of the month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{八月|はちがつ}→八月：00626_hachigatsu⟧{末|まつ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}して→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please submit it by the end of August.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年度|ねんど}{末|まつ}→年度末：10202_nendomatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}くて→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦{毎晩|まいばん}→毎晩：00967_maiban⟧⟦{帰|かえ}り→帰り：01275_kaeri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧。
examples.english: At the end of the fiscal year there is a lot of work, and I get home late every night.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{月末|げつまつ}→月末：00070_getsumatsu⟧: end of the month
- ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧: end of the year
- ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧: weekend
- ⟦{期末|きまつ}→期末：22375_kimatsu⟧: end of a term (⟦{期末|きまつ}→期末：22375_kimatsu⟧⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧, end-of-term exams)
- ⟦{年度末|ねんどまつ}→年度末：10202_nendomatsu⟧: end of the fiscal year (March in Japan)
- ⟦{学期末|がっきまつ}→学期末：27585_gakkimatsu⟧: end of the school term

USAGE:
With a named month, {末|まつ} follows the number directly: ⟦{三月|さんがつ}→三月：00665_sangatsu⟧{末|まつ}, ⟦{八月|はちがつ}→八月：00626_hachigatsu⟧{末|まつ}. In speech, the same idea is often said as ⟦{三月|さんがつ}→三月：00665_sangatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{終|お}わり→終わり：01361_owari⟧.

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with ⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧ (end, as a standalone noun: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧, ⟦{考|かんが}えた→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧, "after much thought"). The suffix まつ attaches only to time words.
